annotation.cut_point:
We are given the problem:

> What is the largest single-digit number that can be filled in □ to make the quotient of □72 ÷ 6 a two-digit number? Express your answer as a single digit.

---

### Step 1: Understand the problem

Let the number filled in the single-digit number be $ x $. So the expression becomes:

$$
\frac{x}{6} \text{ (quotient)} = \text{a two-digit number}
$$
